name: Kayode Chat Lead Capture
author: Damilola Kayode

sections.description:
Kayode Chat Lead Capture is a professional marketing tool designed to help business owners stop losing potential customers. While standard click-to-chat buttons send users away from your site instantly, this plugin acts as a lead-generation gatekeeper.

How it works

When a visitor clicks the floating WhatsApp button, a professional modal appears asking for their Name, Email, and Message. Once submitted, the data is saved locally to your WordPress database. The plugin then automatically pre-fills the visitor’s message into WhatsApp and redirects them to the chat.

Features

  • Lead Capture: Save contact details to a custom database table.
  • Smart Pre-fill: Automatically types the customer’s message into WhatsApp.
  • Analytics: View total clicks and leads captured in your dashboard.
  • GDPR Ready: Includes a mandatory consent checkbox for privacy compliance.
  • CSV Export: Download your leads list for email marketing.

External services

This plugin relies on the official WhatsApp API to facilitate communication between the website visitor and the site owner.

  • Service: WhatsApp Public API
  • Usage: Redirects the user to a WhatsApp chat window with a pre-filled message.
  • Data sent: The visitor’s name and the message they typed in the lead form are passed as URL parameters to the WhatsApp API.
  • Service Link: https://api.whatsapp.com
  • Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/

Pro Version

Take Your Website Chat From Basic Communication to Lead Generation

Kayode Chat Lead Capture Free gives your website a simple way to connect with visitors and start conversations.

Kayode Chat Lead Capture Pro== takes the experience further by turning visitor conversations into a complete lead-generation and customer follow-up system inside WordPress.

With Pro, you can use AI to answer visitor questions, capture contact information, organize leads, measure conversions, and connect qualified visitors with your team through WhatsApp.

Why Upgrade to Pro?

The Free version is designed to help you get started with visitor communication.

The Pro version is designed for businesses that want to capture, manage, qualify, and convert website visitors into leads.

Pro adds:

  • AI-powered conversations using Google Gemini.
  • Custom AI assistant name, status, image, welcome message, and personality.
  • AI conversation context during the visitor’s current interaction.
  • Lead capture for name, WhatsApp/phone number, email address, and inquiry.
  • Automatic extraction of contact information from visitor conversations when available.
  • Lead scoring from 0 to 100.
  • Built-in CRM-style Leads List inside WordPress.
  • Search leads by name, email, or phone number.
  • Filter leads by New, Contacted, Qualified, Converted, or Lost status.
  • View lead contact information and conversation history.
  • View lead source page, device, browser, and available country information.
  • Manually create leads.
  • Bulk delete leads.
  • Export leads to CSV.
  • Advanced Analytics dashboard.
  • Visitor, conversation, lead, and WhatsApp click metrics.
  • Conversion Rate and AI Resolution metrics.
  • Daily performance reporting.
  • Conversion Funnel showing Visitors, Conversations, Leads, and WhatsApp Clicks.
  • Traffic Source reporting for Direct, Search, Social, and Referral traffic.
  • Mobile and Desktop device reporting.
  • Top-performing pages reporting.
  • Active user and new lead activity metrics.
  • Analytics report export.
  • WhatsApp human handoff.
  • Pre-filled WhatsApp messages for easier follow-up.
  • Multi-agent/team support.
  • Allow visitors to select an active team member before WhatsApp handoff.
  • Configurable team member names, roles, and WhatsApp numbers.
  • Option to show or hide the “Talk to a Human on WhatsApp” button.
  • Pro license activation and verification.

How Kayode Chat Lead Capture Pro Works

The Pro version connects the visitor journey into one workflow:

Visitor → AI Conversation → Lead Capture → Lead Scoring → CRM → WhatsApp → Analytics

  1. A visitor opens the chat

    The visitor clicks the floating chat button on your WordPress website.

  2. The visitor starts a conversation

    If AI Chatbot is enabled, the visitor can ask questions and receive responses from Google Gemini.

  3. The conversation collects useful information

    The visitor can provide their name, phone number, email address, and inquiry through the conversation or lead form.

  4. The lead is captured

    Pro saves the available contact information, inquiry, conversation summary, source information, and other available attribution data in your WordPress database.

  5. The lead receives a score

    Pro calculates a lead score based on the information available for the lead, helping you identify more complete and potentially valuable inquiries.

  6. The lead appears in your CRM

    Administrators can review leads from the WordPress dashboard, search and filter records, view conversation history, manage lead status, and export lead data.

  7. The visitor can be connected to WhatsApp

    When a visitor wants to speak with a real person, Pro can hand the conversation over to WhatsApp with a pre-filled message.

  8. Teams can receive leads

    With Multi-Agent Mode enabled, visitors can select an active team member before the WhatsApp handoff.

  9. You can measure the entire journey

    The Analytics dashboard helps you understand how visitors move through your website:

    Visitors → Conversations → Leads → WhatsApp Clicks

Free vs Pro

Free

A simple way to add visitor communication and WhatsApp functionality to your WordPress website.

Pro

A complete AI-powered lead capture and conversion system that combines:

AI Chat + Lead Capture + CRM + Lead Scoring + Analytics + WhatsApp + Multi-Agent Handoff

The Pro version is built for businesses that want more than just a chat button. It helps turn website conversations into organized leads that can be followed up and measured.

Get Kayode Chat Lead Capture Pro

Unlock the complete lead-generation features and take your WordPress website’s visitor communication to the next level.

Get Kayode Chat Lead Capture Pro:

https://wpwhatsappbutton.gumroad.com/l/kayode-chat-pro

Note: AI functionality requires a Google Gemini API key. Google Gemini API usage is subject to Google’s applicable API limits, availability, and pricing.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the kayode-chat-lead-capture folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘Kayode Chat’ menu in your sidebar to configure your settings.
